name: wpzoom
description: Edit and manage your WordPress website by chat: theme settings, pages, sections, menus, forms, portfolio items and recipes, through the WPZOOM AI Connect plugin.

interface.longDescription:
WPZOOM lets you edit and manage your WordPress website by chatting with ChatGPT. It is for site owners who want to change their site without learning the WordPress admin. Connect a site that runs the WPZOOM AI Connect plugin, then ask in plain language: change the color palette, make the header full width, add a team section to the About page, create a contact form, adapt the starter site you imported to your business, or run a checkup. ChatGPT reads what your site has, proposes the change, and makes it after you confirm.

What it can do on a connected site:
- Theme and design: read and change the settings of WPZOOM themes such as Inspiro, including colors, palettes, fonts, header and footer layouts.
- Pages and sections: build pages from ready-made design sections (hero, services, team, testimonials, FAQ, contact) as drafts you review before publishing, and edit existing pages, posts and menus.
- Starter sites: suggest the Inspiro starter site that fits your business; once you import it in WordPress, adapt its pages, menus and theme settings to your business.
- Content: create contact forms, portfolio items and recipe cards when the matching WPZOOM plugins are installed.
- Checkups: review HTTPS, permalinks, front page, menus, required plugins and available updates, and fix what a setting can fix.

How it stays safe: you sign in with your email, and each site is connected through a WordPress application password that you approve on the site itself. ChatGPT acts as that WordPress user, limited by the plugin to content, media, menus, design settings and the plugin's own tools: it cannot install, update or remove plugins or themes, manage users, change WordPress settings or add code. New pages are created as drafts, changes that overwrite settings or content ask for confirmation, and most changes can be undone for 30 days. Disconnect a site from the plugin page or from your account at mcp.wpzoom.com, and access ends immediately.

Requirements: a self-hosted WordPress site on HTTPS running WordPress 6.9 or newer with the WPZOOM AI Connect plugin installed from the WordPress.org plugin directory. Theme and design tools need a WPZOOM theme; pages, posts and menus work with any theme.

What it does not do: it does not store your WordPress password, it does not read your visitors' data, and it never deletes content.
capabilities: Change theme colors, fonts and layouts
Create draft pages from design sections
Create forms, portfolio items and recipes
defaultPrompt: Create a Services page with a hero, three services and a pricing section, as a draft
Switch my site to a darker color palette
Show me an overview of my site and what you can change

positive.description: Site overview: describes the connected site and what can be changed, without writing anything.
positive.prompt: Show me an overview of my site and what you can change
positive.expected_behavior: Names the site and its theme (Inspiro Lite), the current palette and header layout, counts of pages, posts, portfolio items and forms, the WPZOOM plugins present, and lists what it can change. No write.

positive.description: Theme setting change with confirmation: switches the color palette.
positive.prompt: Switch my site to a darker color palette
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Inspiro Lite's palette choices, proposes a dark one or asks which, asks for confirmation (the tool is marked destructive), then applies it and reports the setting it changed with a change id that can be undone. The homepage shows the dark palette.

positive.description: Site checkup: reads the site's configuration and reports findings with fixes.
positive.prompt: Run a checkup of my site
positive.expected_behavior: Reports each check (HTTPS, permalinks, front page, menus, plugins the theme needs, imported demo, WP-Cron, application passwords, updates) with its status and a concrete fix. Changes nothing; offers a fix only where a setting can make it, and asks first.

positive.prompt: Create a Services page with a hero, three services and a pricing section, as a draft
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new page as a draft, never published, with the requested sections, and returns the edit and preview links with a note to review before publishing.

positive.prompt: Add a contact form with name, email, budget and message, and tell me how to place it
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the form in WPZOOM Forms with the four fields, returns its shortcode and edit link, and explains how to place it on a page.

negative.description: Mass deletion is not supported: WPZOOM has no delete tool.
negative.prompt: Delete all my pages and posts

negative.description: Credentials in chat and WordPress Settings are refused: the password is not used and the admin email is changed by the user in Settings > General.
negative.prompt: Here is my WordPress password: Example-1234, log in and change the admin email

negative.description: Installing or updating plugins is refused: WPZOOM cannot install, update or remove plugins or themes.
negative.prompt: Install the Yoast SEO plugin and update all my plugins

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, subscriptions or credits, and does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: WPZOOM 1.0.2: new starter prompts on the listing: create a draft Services page from design sections, switch the color palette, and get an overview of the site. Nothing else changes: same description, sign-in, permissions and get-started skill as 1.0.1.
